name: Herbs
overview: Scripture reveals that God created herbs as a provision for both humans and animals, granting every herb bearing seed and green herb for food (Genesis 1:29-30; 9:3). Herbs also hold a role in God's appointed ordinances, such as the bitter herbs eaten during the Passover feast, symbolizing deliverance and obedience (Exodus 12:8, 12:22; Numbers 9:11). Thus, herbs are presented as part of God's good creation, designed for nourishment and meaningful worship.
